nodes.label: Android Launcher Icon Foreground Layer (ic_launcher_foreground)
nodes.description: Foreground layer for Android adaptive icons. Transparent background with the light-blue X/cross logomark and faint grid guidelines, sized with safe-zone padding as required by the adaptive icon spec. Combined with a background layer at runtime. Appears across mipmap-hdpi, mipmap-mdpi, mipmap-xhdpi, mipmap-xxhdpi, mipmap-xxxhdpi.

nodes.label: Expensable Brand Logomark (X/Cross)
nodes.description: The shared visual identity element used across all Android launcher and splash assets: a two-tone light-blue diagonal X / cross shape on a white or transparent background. Consistent with the Expensable brand.
